name: Jang Kyu-jin
bio: Jang Kyu-jin, known mononymously as Kyujin, is a South Korean singer, rapper and dancer under JYP Entertainment. She is the maknae of the girl group NMIXX.

credits.title: NMIXX 1ST WORLD TOUR 〈EPISODE 1: ZERO FRONTIER〉 FINALE IN INCHEON LIVE VIEWING
credits.overview: From Incheon to the world, and back to where it all began. NMIXX brings their first world tour to an unforgettable finale, broadcast live to cinemas worldwide for NSWER to experience together.

credits.title: NMIXX: The First Note
credits.overview: A three-part documentary series following NMIXX's journey and history both before and after their official debut.

credits.title: NMIXX 1st World Tour Episode 1: Zero Frontier Incheon Day 2
credits.overview: NMIXX 1st World Tour Episode 1: Zero Frontier is the group’s first world tour, opening with two shows at Inspire Arena in Incheon, South Korea, on November 29-30, 2025.

credits.title: NMIXX 2nd Fan Concert "NMIXX Change Up : MIXX Lab"
credits.overview: This is s the second fan concert by NMIXX.  The fan concert was first held in Seoul from October 4 until October 6, 2024 at Jangchung Arena, and later held in Tokyo from January 11 and January 12, 2025 at LaLa arena TOKYO-BAY.
